1.title: Hegseth Renames Base for Lindsey Graham
1.summary: Joint Base Charleston will now be known as Joint Base Lindsey Graham. The senator served as a judge advocate general before retiring as a colonel in 2015.

2.title: One Source of Paxton’s Wealth: A Cell Tower at a Hospital He Knew Well
2.summary: Ken Paxton, the Texas attorney general, makes six-figure income from a cellphone tower on the grounds of a hospital where he was a board member.

3.title: How Trump’s Yearlong ‘Takeover’ of Washington Has Changed the Capital
3.summary: The deployment of National Guard troops and federal agents into the streets has been expensive. How effective it has been is debatable.

4.title: Live Updates: Powerful 7.4 Earthquake Strikes Colombia, Killing Dozens
4.summary: The quake shook several major cities, including Bogotá, Cali and Medellín. More than 70 people have died, and the death toll appeared likely to rise as rescuers continued to search damaged buildings.

5.title: Netanyahu Walks Tightrope on Trump’s Gaza Disarmament Deal
5.summary: The Israeli prime minister, facing a tough upcoming election, is trying to satisfy the sometimes competing demands of his right-wing base and of President Trump.

6.title: New train service connects Finland and Sweden for first time in decades
6.summary: The service will enable rail travel from Portugal to Lapland - what is believed to be the longest train journey in Europe.
